thread.preview:
Execute a disposable installed Novel Creator automated evaluation. The human has explicitly authorized creation and driving of these evaluation chats in the parent chat. Do not create or message any other chat, call model/provider APIs, change global configuration/dependencies, edit the framework, inspect hidden transcript files, or modify existing novels.

Framework C:/Users/BjarkiGunnarsson/source/repos/Personal/novel-creator
Python C:/Users/BjarkiGunnarsson/source/repos/Personal/novel-creator/.venv/Scripts/python.exe
Expected delegated parent thread: 01a16af6-0d9b-7173-a5f5-c8775f37df18

Create ONE NEW independent disposable novel under your task's own workspace, outside every other Git repository. Configure only its local Git identity as Evaluation/evaluation@example.invalid. Initialize via the current framework production CLI with all creative preferences unknown and only the manuscript language below; after installation use the novel-local pinned .novel-creator/run.py with no framework PYTHONPATH. Read installed entry.md, brainstorm.md, authority.md, continuity.md and resume.md and adapter instructions. Do not bypass any source/authority/storage/path/hash/lock safeguards.

On THIS and every subsequent turn: retrieve current CODEX_THREAD_ID and public current turn using codex_app read_thread with turnLimit 1, includeOutputs true and sufficient maxOutputCharsPerItem (e.g. 40000). Serialize its complete current public functionCallOutput delegation input exactly; exclude reasoning and unrelated tool output. Do not reconstruct the prompt from memory, parent expected strings or shell here-strings. A metadata-only/truncated read is insufficient; fetch complete public outputs before parsing. Write public capture to .novel-creator/local/evidence/<case>-input.json. Invoke installed input capture --capture-file FILE --thread-id CURRENT --turn-id ACTUAL --source delegated --source-thread-id 01a16af6-0d9b-7173-a5f5-c8775f37df18 --evaluation-only --json. Retain the capture result. Use exactly data.text as the exchange user text and include data.input_artifact unchanged; administrative instructions are not story decisions.

Process subsequent simulated director requests through the installed workflows automatically, choosing response, extraction, continuity and authority judgments yourself. Do not receive prepared response text or prepared creative record payloads from the parent. Use local record constructors and production save; sources must resolve exact real current message spans. Preserve all relevant capture kinds, questions/session links and record history. Save before displaying the exact reply with no unsaved suffix or report, no extra memory citation. A normal-filesystem scoped retry is allowed if sandbox hard links are denied; retain IDs and pending payload and never bypass locks. On any product/schema failure preserve the attempted payload, raw errors and checkpoint and stop honestly; do not alter the product's validators or invent a passing result.

For this initial administrative GATE turn, prepare the fixed noncreative response "Evaluation workspace is ready." with no canon or session changes; continuity not_applicable. Save it and display exactly. Store .novel-creator/local/evidence/GATE-report.json with novel absolute path, thread/turn IDs, full save result, manifest digest, available host/model/version (unknown where unavailable), source_type delegated, native_user_input false, novice_evidence false. Store a pointer at outputs/phase22-pointer.json in your task workspace. Retain all future per-turn input/capture/payload/save/report files under local/evidence with case IDs supplied by parent; reports identify record IDs and versions but do not self-award semantic correctness. Reports must include full save result as compact JSON printed to command output so the parent can establish save-before-display ordering. All administration belongs in files and tool output; final response is the saved text only.
Configured manuscript language: is
Case ID: GATE

items.text: Vistunin er í bið eftir skráakerfisvillu. Ég endurtek hana með óbreyttu auðkenni og óbreyttum gögnum.

Ég get ekki lesið samhengi lotu 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000169; umbeðin lota er ekki tiltæk samkvæmt samhengislestrinum. Því get ég hvorki sagt hvaða æskuatburður var valinn þar né staðfest hann. Ákvörðunin stendur ótekin og ég álykta ekkert um valið út frá annarri lotu.

Aðskilda hugmyndin um látúnsspeglun er áfram óstaðfest tillaga (da64b265 v1). Hún er ekki heimild um valið í umbeðinni lotu.
